### table and figure functions

## for exposure or phenotypes
plot_adjusted_r2_cdf <- function(to_plot) {
  p <- ggplot(to_plot, aes(r2_adjusted_vs_base, color=sig_levels))
  p <- p + stat_ecdf() + scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::label_percent()) + study_sig_color()
  p <- p + study_theme() + xlab("Additional variance explained (ΔR²)") + ylab("Cumulative proportion of pairs")
  p <- p + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  p
}


plot_volcano <- function(to_plot, bg=NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(to_plot, aes(estimate, -log10(p.value), color=sig_levels))
  p <- p + geom_point(shape = 1, size = 1) # color = "black")
  if(!is.null(bg)) {
    p <- p + geom_point(data=bg, aes(estimate, -log10(p.value)), alpha=.01)
  }
  p <- p + scale_x_continuous() + study_sig_color()
  p <- p + study_theme() + xlab("Standardized coefficient β (original contrast)") + ylab("−log10 coefficient P (capped at 20)")
  p
}

plot_estimates <- function(to_plot) {
  validate(need(nrow(to_plot)>0, "No model comparison available for this selection."))
  p <- ggplot(to_plot, aes(x=estimate_unadjusted, y=estimate))
  p <- p + geom_point(shape = 1, size = 1.7, color = study_colors[["blue"]]) + scale_x_continuous() + scale_y_continuous()
  p <- p + geom_abline(linetype="dashed")
  p <- p + xlab("Base-model coefficient β") + ylab("Fully adjusted coefficient β")
  p <- p + study_theme()
  p
}


reactable_tibble <- function(meta_obj) {
  meta_obj |> transmute(p_description=pvardesc, e_description=evardesc, comparison,
    effect.size=estimate, ci_low, ci_high, r.squared=rsq_adjusted_base_diff,
    p.value=p, BY=q, Bonferroni=bonferroni_p, sig_levels,
    total_sample_size=total_n, n_surveys=nobs, I2=i.squared.uwls,
    exposure_id=evarname, phenotype_id=pvarname, pair_id, contrast, years)
}

reactable_summary_stats <- function(meta_obj) {
  display <- reactable_tibble(meta_obj)
  reactable(display, defaultSorted=list(r.squared="desc"), searchable=TRUE,
    defaultPageSize=10, showPageSizeOptions=TRUE, pageSizeOptions=c(10,25,50),
    striped=FALSE, highlight=FALSE, bordered=FALSE, compact=TRUE,
    defaultColDef=colDef(minWidth=85), columns=list(
      p_description=colDef(name="Phenotype",minWidth=145),
      e_description=colDef(name="Exposure",minWidth=170),
      comparison=colDef(name="Contrast",minWidth=125),
      effect.size=colDef(name="β",format=colFormat(digits=3)),
      ci_low=colDef(name="95% CI low",format=colFormat(digits=3)),
      ci_high=colDef(name="95% CI high",format=colFormat(digits=3)),
      r.squared=colDef(name="ΔR²",format=colFormat(digits=4)),
      p.value=colDef(name="P",cell=function(v) format(v,digits=3,scientific=TRUE)),
      BY=colDef(name="BY q",cell=function(v) format(v,digits=3,scientific=TRUE)),
      Bonferroni=colDef(show=FALSE),sig_levels=colDef(name="Significance",minWidth=110),
      total_sample_size=colDef(name="N",format=colFormat(separators=TRUE)),
      n_surveys=colDef(name="Years"),I2=colDef(name="I² (%)",format=colFormat(digits=1)),
      exposure_id=colDef(show=FALSE),phenotype_id=colDef(show=FALSE),
      pair_id=colDef(show=FALSE),contrast=colDef(show=FALSE),years=colDef(show=FALSE)))
}



plot_manhattan <- function(to_plot) {
  PCAP <- 20
  ## order in terms of number found; or R2.
  enewsubcategory_order <- to_plot |> filter(sig_levels == 'Bonf.<0.05') |> group_by(enewsubcategory) |> summarize(med_r2=mean(rsq_adjusted_base_diff)) |> arrange(-med_r2) |> mutate(group_number = row_number())

  to_plot <- to_plot |> left_join(enewsubcategory_order |> select(enewsubcategory, group_number))
  eplot_order <- to_plot |> select(evarname ,enewsubcategory, group_number) |> unique() |> arrange(group_number) |> mutate(order_number = row_number())

  xaxis_labels <- eplot_order |> group_by(group_number,enewsubcategory) |> summarize(med_x=round(median(order_number)), min_x=min(order_number), max_x=max(order_number))
  to_plot <- to_plot |> left_join(eplot_order |> select(evarname,order_number))
  p <- ggplot(to_plot |> arrange(order_number), aes(order_number, -log10(p.value)))
  p <- p + geom_point(aes(color=sig_levels), shape=20) + study_sig_color()
  p <- p + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, PCAP+1))
  p <- p + scale_x_continuous(breaks = xaxis_labels$med_x,  labels = stringr::str_wrap(xaxis_labels$enewsubcategory, 20))
  p <- p + geom_vline(data=xaxis_labels, aes(xintercept=max_x), linetype='dotted', col = 'black') + study_theme()
  #p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
  p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
  p1 <- p + xlab("") + ylab("−log10 P (capped at 20)")

  p <- ggplot(to_plot |> arrange(order_number), aes(order_number, rsq_adjusted_base_diff))
  p <- p + geom_point(aes(color=sig_levels), shape=20) + study_sig_color()
  p <- p + scale_x_continuous(breaks = xaxis_labels$med_x,  labels = stringr::str_wrap(xaxis_labels$enewsubcategory, 20))
  p <- p + geom_vline(data=xaxis_labels, aes(xintercept=max_x), linetype='dotted', col = 'black') + study_theme()
  p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
  p2 <- p + xlab("") + ylab("ΔR²")
  legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p1 + theme(legend.position="top"))
  panels <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1 + theme(legend.position="none"),
    p2 + theme(legend.position="none"), nrow=2, rel_heights=c(1,1.4))
  combined <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(legend, panels, ncol=1,
    heights=grid::unit.c(sum(legend$height), grid::unit(1,"npc")-sum(legend$height)))
  cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_grob(grid::grobTree(combined))
}

plot_effect_size <- function(to_plot) {
  # distribution
  pvarname_lcl <- unique(to_plot$pvarname)[1]
  p <- ggplot(to_plot |> filter(!is.na(sig_levels)) |> mutate(sig_levels = factor(sig_levels, levels=c("> BY & Bonf.", "BY<0.05", "Bonf.<0.05"))),
              aes(y=exposure_level, x=I(abs(estimate)), fill=sig_levels))
  p <- p + geom_violin(orientation = "y", scale = "width", width = 0.5)
  #p <- p + geom_histogram(orientation = "y", width = 0.5)
  p <- p + xlab("Absolute Value Effect Size [1 Unit of Phenotype (original units)]") + ylab("Quantile of Exposure") + ylab("Percentile of Exposure")
  p <- p + study_sig_fill()
  p <- p + study_theme() + coord_flip() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  p
}
plot_effect_size_box <- function(to_plot) {

  to_plot <- to_plot |>
    filter(!is.na(sig_levels)) |>
    mutate(
      sig_levels = factor(sig_levels, levels = c("> BY & Bonf.", "BY<0.05", "Bonf.<0.05")),
      exposure_level = factor(exposure_level)
    )


  p <- ggplot(to_plot, aes(x = exposure_level, y = abs(estimate), fill = sig_levels)) +
    # notch = TRUE can help show if medians differ significantly
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +

    # Flip the coordinates to make it horizontal
    coord_flip() +

    xlab("Exposure group") +
    ylab("Absolute standardized coefficient |β|") +
    study_sig_fill() +
    study_theme() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  return(p)
}

globe_data <- function(exposure_tibble) {
  ids <- unique(exposure_tibble$evarname)
  edges <- ee |> filter(variable_x %in% ids, variable_y %in% ids,
    abs(estimate)>.25, p_bonferroni<.05) |> arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) |> head(100)
  nodes <- network_nodes |> filter(node_id %in% c(edges$xvarname, edges$yvarname)) |>
    mutate(abbr=sprintf("E%02d",row_number()),
      category=unname(domain_names[category]))
  list(edges=edges,nodes=nodes)
}

exposome_globe_plot <- function(exposure_tibble) {
  d <- globe_data(exposure_tibble)
  validate(need(nrow(d$edges)>0,"No partial correlations meet the selected thresholds."))
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(d$edges |> select(xvarname,yvarname,estimate), directed=FALSE,
    vertices=d$nodes |> select(node_id,everything()))
  E(g)$color <- ifelse(E(g)$estimate>0,study_colors[["red"]],study_colors[["blue"]])
  coords <- layout_in_circle(g)
  par(mar=c(0,0,0,0))
  plot(g, layout=coords, vertex.size=10, vertex.color=MASTER_COLORS[V(g)$category],
    vertex.label=V(g)$abbr, vertex.label.cex=.7, vertex.label.color=study_colors[["ink"]],
    vertex.label.family="sans", edge.curved=FALSE,
    edge.width=sqrt(abs(E(g)$estimate))*4)
  legend("bottomleft",legend=c("Positive","Negative"),
    col=study_colors[c("red","blue")],lty=1,lwd=2,bty="n",cex=.85)
}


write_summary_csv <- function(x, file) {
  formatted <- x |> mutate(across(where(is.double),
    ~ifelse(is.na(.x), NA_character_, sprintf("%.17g", .x))))
  readr::write_csv(formatted, file, na="")
}

# server logic
server <- function(input, output, session) {
    vibration_server(input, output, session)
    # Parse URL query parameters to set dropdowns and navigate to the right tab
    observe({
      query <- parseQueryString(input$atlas_url_search)
      if (!is.null(query$phenotype) && query$phenotype %in% p_variables$pvarname) {
        updateSelectInput(session, "pvarname", selected = query$phenotype)
        updateNavbarPage(session, "main_nav", selected = "Browse By Phenotype")
      }
      if (!is.null(query$exposure) && query$exposure %in% e_variables$evarname) {
        updateSelectInput(session, "evarname", selected = query$exposure)
        updateNavbarPage(session, "main_nav", selected = "Browse By Exposure")
      }
      if (!is.null(query$group) && query$group %in% e_category_strs$cat_subcat) {
        updateSelectInput(session, "egroup", selected = query$group)
        updateNavbarPage(session, "main_nav", selected = "Browse by Exposure Group")
      }
    }) |> bindEvent(input$atlas_url_search, once = TRUE)

    # Copy link buttons - show modal with selectable link
    observeEvent(input$copy_pheno_link, {
      base_url <- input$atlas_site_url
      link <- paste0(base_url, "?phenotype=", input$pvarname)
      showModal(modalDialog(
        title = "Shareable Link",
        tags$input(type = "text", value = link, id = "share_link_text",
                   style = "width:100%; padding:8px; font-size:14px;", readonly = "readonly"),
        tags$script(HTML("document.getElementById('share_link_text').select();")),
        footer = modalButton("Close"),
        easyClose = TRUE
      ))
    })

    observeEvent(input$copy_expo_link, {
      base_url <- input$atlas_site_url
      link <- paste0(base_url, "?exposure=", input$evarname)
      showModal(modalDialog(
        title = "Shareable Link",
        tags$input(type = "text", value = link, id = "share_link_text",
                   style = "width:100%; padding:8px; font-size:14px;", readonly = "readonly"),
        tags$script(HTML("document.getElementById('share_link_text').select();")),
        footer = modalButton("Close"),
        easyClose = TRUE
      ))
    })

    observeEvent(input$copy_group_link, {
      base_url <- input$atlas_site_url
      link <- paste0(base_url, "?group=", URLencode(input$egroup, reserved = TRUE))
      showModal(modalDialog(
        title = "Shareable Link",
        tags$input(type = "text", value = link, id = "share_link_text",
                   style = "width:100%; padding:8px; font-size:14px;", readonly = "readonly"),
        tags$script(HTML("document.getElementById('share_link_text').select();")),
        footer = modalButton("Close"),
        easyClose = TRUE
      ))
    })

    output$by_phenotype_volcano_plot <- renderPlot({
        pvarn <- input$pvarname
        pcat <- p_variables |> filter(pvarname == pvarn) |> pull(pcategory)

        #to_plot <- tbl(pool, "adjusted_meta_2") |> filter(pvarname == pvarn) |> select(estimate, p.value, sig_levels) |> collect()
        to_plot <-adjusted_meta_2 |> filter(pvarname == pvarn) |> select(estimate, p.value, sig_levels)
        to_plot <- to_plot |> mutate(p.value = ifelse(p.value < 1e-20, 1e-20, p.value))
        #bg <- tbl(pool, "adjusted_meta_2") |> filter(pcategory == pcat) |> select(estimate, p.value, sig_levels) |> collect()
        bg <- adjusted_meta_2 |> filter(pcategory == pcat) |> select(estimate, p.value, sig_levels) #|> collect()
        bg <- bg |> mutate(p.value = ifelse(p.value < 1e-20, 1e-20, p.value))
        plot_volcano(to_plot, bg)
    })

    output$by_phenotype_manhattan_plot <- renderPlot({
      pvarn <-input$pvarname
      pcat <- p_variables |> filter(pvarname == pvarn) |> pull(pcategory)
      #to_plot <- tbl(pool, "adjusted_meta_2") |> filter(pvarname == pvarn) |> collect()
      to_plot <- adjusted_meta_2 |> filter(pvarname == pvarn)
      to_plot <- to_plot |> mutate(p.value = ifelse(p.value < 1e-20, 1e-20, p.value))
      plot_manhattan(to_plot)
    })


    output$by_phenotype_globe_plot <- renderPlot({
      pvarn <-input$pvarname
      #exposures_to_plot <- tbl(pool, "adjusted_meta_2") |> filter(pvarname == pvarn, sig_levels == "Bonf.<0.05")|> select(evarname)
      exposures_to_plot <- adjusted_meta_2 |> filter(pvarname == pvarn, sig_levels == "Bonf.<0.05")|> select(evarname)
      validate(need(nrow(exposures_to_plot) > 0, "No exposures pass the Bonferroni significance threshold for this phenotype."))
      exposome_globe_plot(exposure_tibble = exposures_to_plot)
    })
    output$by_phenotype_globe_legend_table <- renderDT({
      selected <- adjusted_meta_2 |> filter(pvarname==input$pvarname,sig_levels=="Bonf.<0.05") |> select(evarname)
      legend <- globe_data(selected)$nodes |> select(Abbreviation=abbr,Exposure=label,Category=category)
      datatable(legend, rownames=FALSE, class="compact", options=list(pageLength=10))
    })
    output$by_phenotype_effect_size <-renderPlot({
      pvarn <-input$pvarname
      pcat <- p_variables |> filter(pvarname == pvarn) |> pull(pcategory)
      #es <- tbl(pool, "pe_quantile_ns") |> filter(pvarname == pvarn) |> collect()
      es <- pe_quantile_ns |> filter(pvarname == pvarn) #|> collect()
      plot_effect_size_box(es)
    })

    output$by_phenotype_r2_plot <- renderPlot({
        pvarn <- input$pvarname
        #to_plot <- tbl(pool, "adjusted_meta_2") |> filter(pvarname==pvarn) |> distinct(pair_id,.keep_all=TRUE) |> transmute(rsq_adjusted_base_diff,rsq_adjusted_diff=NA_real_,sig_levels=pair_sig_levels) |> collect()
        to_plot <- adjusted_meta_2 |> filter(pvarname==pvarn) |> distinct(pair_id,.keep_all=TRUE) |> transmute(rsq_adjusted_base_diff,rsq_adjusted_diff=NA_real_,sig_levels=pair_sig_levels) #|> collect()
        to_plot <- to_plot |> rename(r2_adjusted_vs_base=rsq_adjusted_base_diff, r2_adjusted_vs_unadjusted=rsq_adjusted_diff)
        plot_adjusted_r2_cdf(to_plot)
    })

# Browser deployment reads the same result rows from one phenotype chunk at a time.
.voe_cache <- new.env(parent=emptyenv())
.voe_cache$phenotype <- NULL
voe_read <- function(kind, pair, contrast=NULL) {
  phenotype <- voe_summary$phenotype_id[match(pair, voe_summary$pair_id)]
  stopifnot(length(phenotype)==1L, !is.na(phenotype), kind %in% c('models','terms','drivers'))
  if (!identical(.voe_cache$phenotype, phenotype)) {
    local_site <- Sys.getenv('KNHANES_LOCAL_SITE')
    if (nzchar(local_site)) {
      path <- file.path(local_site, 'data/voe', paste0(phenotype,'.rds'))
      chunk <- readRDS(path)
    } else {
      base <- shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()$input$atlas_site_url
      shiny::req(!is.null(base), nzchar(base))
      path <- tempfile(fileext='.rds')
      on.exit(unlink(path), add=TRUE)
      utils::download.file(paste0(base, 'data/voe/', phenotype, '.rds'), path,
        mode='wb', quiet=TRUE)
      chunk <- readRDS(path)
    }
    .voe_cache$data <- chunk
    .voe_cache$phenotype <- phenotype
  }
  x <- .voe_cache$data[[kind]]
  x <- x[x$pair_id==pair,,drop=FALSE]
  if (!is.null(contrast)) x <- x[x$contrast_id==contrast,,drop=FALSE]
  rownames(x) <- NULL
  x
}

        )
      )
    )
  )
}

vibration_server <- function(input, output, session) {
  phenotype_rows <- reactive({
    req(input$voe_phenotype)
    voe_summary[voe_summary$phenotype_id==input$voe_phenotype, , drop=FALSE]
  })
  observeEvent(input$voe_phenotype, {
    x <- unique(phenotype_rows()[c('exposure_id','exposure')])
    current <- isolate(input$voe_exposure)
    selected <- if (!is.null(current) && current %in% x$exposure_id) current else x$exposure_id[1]
    updateSelectInput(session,'voe_exposure',choices=setNames(x$exposure_id,x$exposure),selected=selected)
  })
  pair_rows <- reactive({
    req(input$voe_exposure)
    x <- phenotype_rows()
    x[x$exposure_id==input$voe_exposure, , drop=FALSE]
  })
  observeEvent(pair_rows(), {
    x <- pair_rows(); req(nrow(x)>0)
    current <- isolate(input$voe_contrast)
    selected <- if (!is.null(current) && current %in% x$contrast_id) current else x$contrast_id[1]
    updateSelectInput(session,'voe_contrast',choices=setNames(x$contrast_id,x$contrast_label),selected=selected)
  })
  chosen <- reactive({
    req(input$voe_contrast)
    x <- pair_rows(); x <- x[x$contrast_id==input$voe_contrast, , drop=FALSE]
    req(nrow(x)==1L); x
  })
  models <- reactive({
    x <- chosen()
    m <- voe_read('models',x$pair_id)
    t <- voe_read('terms',x$pair_id,x$contrast_id)
    d <- merge(m,t,by=c('pair_id','model_id'),all.x=TRUE,sort=FALSE)
    d$contrast_id <- x$contrast_id
    d$contrast_label <- x$contrast_label
    d$level_label <- x$level
    d$reference_label <- x$reference
    d$minus_log10_p <- -d$log_p_value/log(10)
    valid <- which(is.finite(d$beta) & is.finite(d$minus_log10_p))
    ranked <- valid[order(d$beta[valid],d$model_id[valid])]
    d$model_rank <- NA_integer_
    d$model_rank[ranked] <- seq_along(ranked)
    d
  })
  contributions <- reactive({
    x <- chosen(); voe_read('drivers',x$pair_id,x$contrast_id)
  })
  observe({
    req(identical(input$main_nav, 'Vibration of effects'))
    d <- contributions()
    available <- intersect(names(voe$factors),d$factor[is.finite(d$change_in_absolute_beta)])
    if (!length(available)) available <- names(voe$factors)
    current <- isolate(input$voe_factor)
    selected <- if (!is.null(current) && current %in% available) current else available[1]
    updateSelectInput(session,'voe_factor',choices=setNames(available,unname(voe$factors[available])),selected=selected)
  })
  output$voe_pair_title <- renderText({
    x <- chosen(); paste(x$phenotype, '~', x$exposure)
  })
  output$voe_contrast_text <- renderText(chosen()$contrast_label)
  output$voe_pair_stats <- renderUI({
    x <- chosen()
    values <- c('Estimable models'=paste0(x$n_models,' / ',x$models_planned),
      'Common N'=format(x$n_voe,big.mark=',',scientific=FALSE),
      'P < 0.05'=voe_percent(x$nominal_retention),
      'Bonferroni'=voe_percent(x$original_bonferroni_retention),
      'Positive β'=voe_percent(x$positive_fraction),
      'Sign reversal'=ifelse(x$sign_reversal,'Yes','No'),
      'Significant opposite directions'=ifelse(x$significant_opposite_signs,'Yes','No'))
    div(class='study-table-wrap',tags$table(class='study-table',
      tags$thead(tags$tr(lapply(names(values),tags$th))),
      tags$tbody(tags$tr(lapply(unname(values),tags$td)))))
  })
  output$voe_sample_note <- renderUI({
    x <- chosen()
    div(class='study-table-wrap',tags$table(class='study-table',
      tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th('Analysis'),tags$th('N'),tags$th('β'))),
      tags$tbody(
        tags$tr(tags$td('Original atlas'),tags$td(format(x$n_atlas,big.mark=',')),
          tags$td(sprintf('%.4f',x$original_beta))),
        tags$tr(tags$td('Primary model · common VoE sample'),tags$td(format(x$n_voe,big.mark=',')),
          tags$td(sprintf('%.4f',x$primary_beta))))))
  })
  plot_models <- reactive({
    req(input$voe_factor %in% names(voe$factors))
    d <- models() |> filter(!is.na(model_rank)) |> arrange(model_rank)
    validate(need(nrow(d)>0,'No estimable coefficients for this selection.'))
    d$included <- factor(ifelse(grepl(paste0('\\b',input$voe_factor,'\\b'),d$covariates),
      'Included','Not included'),levels=c('Included','Not included'))
    d$rank <- d$model_rank
    d
  })
  output$voe_scatter <- renderPlot({
    d <- plot_models()
    ggplot(d,aes(beta,minus_log10_p)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept=0,color='#A5AFB8',linewidth=.4,linetype=3) +
      geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(c(.05,.05/26078)),color='#7D8991',linetype=c(2,3),linewidth=.4) +
      geom_point(aes(color=included),size=2.5,alpha=.9) +
      geom_point(data=d[d$model_id=='primary',],aes(shape='Primary model'),
        fill='white',color=study_colors[['ink']],size=3,stroke=.8) +
      annotate('text',x=Inf,y=-log10(c(.05,.05/26078)),
        label=c('P = 0.05','Bonferroni'),hjust=1.08,vjust=-.6,size=3.2,color=study_colors[['ink']]) +
      scale_color_manual(values=c('Included'='#417D95','Not included'='#C5A265'),drop=FALSE) +
      scale_shape_manual(values=c('Primary model'=23)) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(.04,.12))) +
      labs(x=expression('Coefficient '*beta),y=expression(-log[10](P)),
        title=stringr::str_wrap(paste('Adjustment for',voe$factors[[input$voe_factor]]),32),tag='a') +
      voe_theme() + guides(color=guide_legend(order=1),shape=guide_legend(order=2)) +
      theme(legend.box='vertical',legend.spacing.y=grid::unit(0,'pt'),legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0))
  })
  output$voe_driver_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- contributions() |> filter(is.finite(change_in_absolute_beta))
    validate(need(nrow(d)>0,'No estimable covariate contributions for this contrast.'))
    d$label <- stringr::str_wrap(unname(voe$factors[d$factor]),20)
    ggplot(d,aes(change_in_absolute_beta,reorder(label,change_in_absolute_beta))) +
      geom_vline(xintercept=0,color='#7D8991',linewidth=.4) +
      geom_col(aes(fill=change_in_absolute_beta>0),width=.62) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=c('FALSE'='#417D95','TRUE'='#B4604C'),guide='none') +
      scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::label_number(),expand=expansion(mult=.12)) +
      labs(x=expression('Change in |'*beta*'|'),y=NULL,title='Covariate contributions',tag='b') +
      voe_theme() + theme(panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(),axis.text.y=element_text(size=10.5))
  })
  output$voe_specification_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- plot_models()
    factors <- intersect(names(voe$factors),contributions()$factor)
    cells <- do.call(rbind,lapply(factors,function(f) data.frame(
      rank=d$rank,factor=f,included=ifelse(grepl(paste0('\\b',f,'\\b'),d$covariates),
        'Included','Not included'))))
    cells$factor <- factor(cells$factor,levels=rev(factors))
    curve <- ggplot(d,aes(rank,beta,color=included)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept=0,color='#7D8991',linetype=2,linewidth=.4) +
      geom_linerange(aes(ymin=ci_low,ymax=ci_high),alpha=.4,linewidth=.5) +
      geom_point(size=2.2) +
      geom_point(data=d[d$model_id=='primary',],aes(shape='Primary model'),
        fill='white',color=study_colors[['ink']],size=3,stroke=.8) +
      scale_color_manual(values=c('Included'='#417D95','Not included'='#C5A265'),drop=FALSE) +
      scale_shape_manual(values=c('Primary model'=23)) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits=c(.5,nrow(d)+.5),expand=c(0,0)) +
      labs(x=NULL,y=expression('Coefficient '*beta*' (95% CI)'),title='Ordered model estimates',tag='a') +
      voe_theme() + theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        legend.position='top',legend.box='horizontal')
    matrix <- ggplot(cells,aes(rank,factor,fill=included)) +
      geom_tile(width=.9,height=.78) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=c('Included'='#417D95','Not included'='#EDF1F3'),
        breaks=c('Included','Not included')) +
      scale_y_discrete(labels=function(x) stringr::str_wrap(unname(voe$factors[x]),26)) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits=c(.5,nrow(d)+.5),expand=c(0,0),
        breaks=unique(c(1L,round(seq(1,nrow(d),length.out=5)),nrow(d)))) +
      labs(x='Model rank',y=NULL,title='Adjustment specifications',tag='b') +
      voe_theme() + theme(panel.grid=element_blank(),axis.text.y=element_text(size=11),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank())
    cowplot::plot_grid(curve,matrix,ncol=1,align='v',axis='lr',rel_heights=c(1.1,1))
  })
  output$voe_model_table <- renderReactable({
    m <- models()
    optional <- vapply(m$covariates,function(formula) {
      included <- vapply(names(voe$factors),function(field) grepl(paste0('\\b',field,'\\b'),formula),logical(1))
      if(!any(included)) 'None' else paste(unname(voe$factors[included]),collapse=', ')
    },character(1))
    d <- m |> transmute(Rank=model_rank,Model=ifelse(model_id=='primary','Primary',model_id),
      Status=ifelse(status=='ok','Fitted',gsub('_',' ',status)),N=n,Beta=beta,
      `95% CI lower`=ci_low,`95% CI upper`=ci_high,P=p_value,`−log10(P)`=minus_log10_p,
      `Optional covariates`=optional,Reason=reason)
    reactable(d,searchable=TRUE,defaultPageSize=8,compact=TRUE,defaultSorted=list(Rank='asc'),
      defaultColDef=colDef(minWidth=90,format=colFormat(digits=4)),
      columns=list(Rank=colDef(minWidth=60,format=colFormat(digits=0)),
        N=colDef(format=colFormat(digits=0)),`Optional covariates`=colDef(minWidth=250),
        P=colDef(cell=function(value) if(is.na(value)) '' else format(value,digits=3,scientific=TRUE)),
        Reason=colDef(show=any(!is.na(d$Reason) & nzchar(d$Reason)))))
  })
  output$voe_results_title <- renderText({paste('Robustness of associations with',phenotype_rows()$phenotype[1])})
  output$voe_summary_table <- renderReactable({
    d <- phenotype_rows() |> transmute(Exposure=exposure,Contrast=contrast_label,N=n_voe,
      `β range`=beta_range,`Nominal retention`=nominal_retention,
      `Bonferroni retention`=original_bonferroni_retention,
      `Sign reversal`=ifelse(sign_reversal,'Yes','No'),
      `Significant opposite directions`=ifelse(significant_opposite_signs,'Yes','No'),Models=n_models)
    reactable(d,searchable=TRUE,defaultPageSize=10,defaultSorted=list('β range'='desc'),compact=TRUE,
      defaultColDef=colDef(minWidth=100),columns=list(Exposure=colDef(minWidth=210),
        Contrast=colDef(minWidth=160),`β range`=colDef(format=colFormat(digits=4)),
        `Nominal retention`=colDef(format=colFormat(percent=TRUE,digits=1)),
        `Bonferroni retention`=colDef(format=colFormat(percent=TRUE,digits=1))))
  })
  output$voe_range_plot <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(voe_summary,aes(beta_range,color=group)) + stat_ecdf(linewidth=.8) +
      scale_x_log10(labels=scales::label_number()) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::label_percent()) + scale_color_manual(values=voe_colors) +
      labs(x=expression('Range of '*beta*' (log scale)'),y='Cumulative proportion',title='Effect variation across the atlas') +
      voe_theme() + guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=2)) +
      theme(legend.position='bottom',legend.text=element_text(size=11))
  })
  metrics <- do.call(rbind,lapply(names(voe_colors),function(g) {
    x <- voe_summary[voe_summary$group==g,]
    data.frame(group=g,metric=c('Nominal significance in every model',
      'Bonferroni significance in at least half','Any sign reversal','Significant opposite directions'),
      n=c(sum(x$nominal_retention==1),sum(x$original_bonferroni_retention>=.5),
        sum(x$sign_reversal),sum(x$significant_opposite_signs)),denominator=nrow(x))
  })) |> mutate(percent=100*n/denominator)
  output$voe_retention_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- metrics; d$metric <- factor(stringr::str_wrap(d$metric,27),
      levels=rev(unique(stringr::str_wrap(d$metric,27))))
    ggplot(d,aes(percent,metric,color=group,group=group)) +
      geom_point(aes(shape=group),position=position_dodge(width=.55),size=3) +
      geom_text(aes(label=sprintf('%.1f%%',percent)),position=position_dodge(width=.55),
        hjust=-.25,size=4,color='#29343D') +
      scale_color_manual(values=voe_colors) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(16,17)) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,115),breaks=c(0,25,50,75,100)) +
      labs(x='Coefficients (%)',y=NULL,title='Robustness across models') +
      voe_theme() + guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=2)) +
      theme(legend.position='bottom',legend.text=element_text(size=11),
        axis.line.y=element_blank(),axis.ticks.y=element_blank())
  })
  output$voe_overview_table <- renderReactable({
    d <- metrics |> transmute(Group=group,Measure=metric,Count=n,Denominator=denominator,Percent=percent)
    reactable(d,pagination=FALSE,defaultColDef=colDef(minWidth=100),
      columns=list(Group=colDef(minWidth=200),Measure=colDef(minWidth=260),Percent=colDef(format=colFormat(digits=1))))
  })
  output$voe_models_download <- downloadHandler(
    filename=function() paste0('VoE_',input$voe_exposure,'_',input$voe_phenotype,'_models.csv'),
    content=function(file) write_summary_csv(models(),file))
  output$voe_drivers_download <- downloadHandler(
    filename=function() paste0('VoE_',input$voe_exposure,'_',input$voe_phenotype,'_contributions.csv'),
    content=function(file) write_summary_csv(contributions(),file))
  output$voe_summary_download <- downloadHandler(
    filename=function() paste0('VoE_',input$voe_phenotype,'_summary.csv'),
    content=function(file) write_summary_csv(phenotype_rows(),file))
}
